title: Scientists Find an Eyeless Snail in a Dark Cave
summary:
Scientists have found a new kind of tiny snail living in a dark cave in China. It is the first freshwater cave snail ever found in that country.

The snail is called Erhaia dijiang. It lives in total darkness, so it has no eyes at all. Its shell is almost see-through, and its body has no color.

Its name comes from an old Chinese story about Di Jiang, a mountain god shown with no face. The snail really dislikes light. In the lab, the snails always hid under rocks when a light was on.

The cave is very high up, about 6,800 feet above sea level. The snails live in shallow water and eat tiny algae that grow on rocks.

But scientists are worried. They found only three living adults and no babies. They want people to study more caves in China and protect these rare snails quickly.
why_it_matters: Finding and protecting rare animals helps keep nature full of amazing living things for kids in the future.
